fixes.explanation: Caleb son of Jephunneh was one of the men sent to spy out Canaan, and Moses is the one who sent them (Numbers 13:3, 6). So I see why his name came up, friend. But Deuteronomy 32:44 says Moses came with Joshua son of Nun. Joshua is the one standing beside him as he recites the song.

Moses says, "Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law." Take it to heart FIRST, then pass it on. You can't hand over what you haven't taken in, baker. Moses has the next generation on his mind.

History is a solid guess, friend, and a song can carry plenty of it. But Moses says, "…they are your life…" and he adds that by them "you will live long in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess." That's more than a story about the past. These words are what Israel will live by in the land ahead.
